description: 30-question minimal validation set for Strategy-Routed GraphRAG. Tests whether per-type retrieval beats current uniform pipeline on aggregation, negation, and multi-hop. All gold answers grounded in graphrag_index/merged_triples.json.
decision_gate: If aggregation gain >=15% (recall@K and exact-match for count) and negation gain >=20% over current pipeline, proceed to full 500-question benchmark. Otherwise reconsider.

questions.baseline_risk: top-k retrieval truncates at ~10-20, count will be wildly wrong
